controls.common_scale_invariance: multiply both endpoint dimensions by 0.5, 2, and 10
controls.obb_only_baseline: fixed sigmoid of predicate-signed annotation-OBB log-volume ratio
controls.point_only_baseline: fixed sigmoid of predicate-signed model-view robust log-volume ratio
controls.wrong_T: same ordered pair with bigger/smaller inverted

evaluation.primary_gate: per source, paired delta-R@100 CI lower > -0.01 and delta-V@100 CI upper < 0
evaluation.promotion_rule: all sources pass both within-relative-size and global-four-family primary gates; controls remain valid

factor_contract.T_e: exact predicate sign: +1 for bigger-than and -1 for smaller-than
factor_contract.T_x_G: predicate sign times signed point-derived ratios and axis dominance
factor_contract.raw_G_e: same-pair absolute point-derived relative extents and volume ratios

model.architecture: inverse-equivariant logistic compatibility model without a standalone predicate bias
model.internal_dev_role: diagnostic and lock decision; no final-validation access

point_evidence.annotation_obb_usage: deterministic baseline only; excluded from learned main C_e
point_evidence.model_view: per-object alternating vertex subset A; p05-p95 xyz extents
point_evidence.verifier_view: disjoint per-object alternating vertex subset B; p02-p98 xyz extents

pre_fit_erratum: The first fit invocation completed before inspection but was rejected without reading metrics because a code-level audit found that standalone predicate biases did not guarantee endpoint-swap inverse equivariance. Its outputs were deleted and this architecture-level correction was frozen before the accepted fit.
